action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not (isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must have the same shape")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) and np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call))):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be finite")
    if not (np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if sum_weights == 0.0:
        normalized_weights = np.zeros_like(raw_weights)
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
    
    # Weighted losses
    L_plus = -np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    
    # Counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    
    # Margins and mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return (keep_mask, margin)
